answer: Let attestation rights draw from a slow hash chain that reveals only one slice per hour, then admit a fixed quota of voters per slice chosen by lottery. A zephyr of fresh clones cannot pull slices forward, so a nebula of them must wander through the same hours a single honest agent would, while every key pays its own entry fee. Over-registering merely deepens the lottery queue, so the expected yield of each additional key falls faster than the farm itself grows.
